title: PackageLaunchSession
description: Scoped learner launch lease for a single package activity occurrence.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

registration_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

occurrence_id.description: Launchable occurrence in the registered organization.
occurrence_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

epoch.description: Fencing epoch pinned to registration writer lease.

origin.description: Approved content origin with no application cookie scope.

bootstrap_digest.description: Hash of short-lived bootstrap nonce, never raw token.

lease_expires_at.description: Server deadline for writing under this epoch.

closed_at.description: Authoritative close or lease expiry time.

credited_time_ms.description: Exact fixed-unit millisecond projection only when duration has no unresolved calendar components.

state.description: Authoritative lifecycle state advanced only through owner commands.

activity_attempt_id.description: Exact occurrence attempt, including distinct browse and review working states.

sco_state_id.description: Authoritative RTE state owned by this exact occurrence attempt.
sco_state_id.x-reference-scope: State belongs to the exact selected activity attempt.

pending_navigation_request.description: Last valid 2004 session-scoped navigation request. Consumed only when its successful terminal transition permits it.

credited_duration.description: Lossless duration sum. Preserve calendar components separately from fixed elapsed units.

reported_duration_lexeme.description: Last valid edition-formatted duration, preserved exactly for traceability.

x-invariants: The grant is limited to one occurrence, learner attempt and epoch.
Time is credited at most once per closed session.
Only hashed bootstrap provenance is stored.
SCO-written adl.nav.request never becomes a cross-launch CMI element. A new launch starts with the edition default request and cannot replay an old suspended or consumed request.
